question: After losing the pistol round, should the team save or buy on round 2?
answer: Buying on round 2: +26.8 pp in round 2, -16.5 pp in round 3, map win -0.8 pp (not different from 0).
findings: CT buy vs save, adjusted: R2 +25.0 pp (+24.0 to +25.9 pp), R3 -17.0 pp (-18.6 to -15.5 pp). 66% of CT losers buy.
T buy vs save, adjusted: R2 +28.3 pp (+27.3 to +29.4 pp), R3 -16.0 pp (-17.6 to -14.5 pp). 50% of T losers buy.
Map win, buy vs save: CT -1.1 pp (-2.6 to +0.3 pp), T -0.8 pp (-2.2 to +0.7 pp).
First-half rounds won (of 12), buy vs save: CT +0.30 (+0.20 to +0.40), T +0.27 (+0.17 to +0.37).
method: Pistol loser's round-2 buy class from bo3.gg equipment value (save = eco, buy = half/force). Logistic models adjust for side, team Elo, winner's round-2 equipment, loser's pistol kills and half; cluster-robust CIs by map.
data: bo3.gg round data, S/A/B-tier pro maps, 2023-10-16 to 2026-11-02, 17,525 maps, 34,640 pistol-loss halves (16,992 CT)
split_check: Map effect early/late: CT -1.1 pp / -1.1 pp, T +0.9 pp / -2.6 pp.
